notes.title: ToN 2.0: Final Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,

First of all, I'd like to thank everyone who has played the game and given me constant feedback, whether positive or negative.

I have reached a point where I have to say that the game is “finished” for me. I simply have too much on my plate at the moment and I don't want to drag this game on for the next few years, but instead devote myself to new challenges.

Nevertheless, the wait since the last update should not have been in vain. The current update brings only a few, but extensive changes to the UI and some mechanics. The game is still far from being “good”, but it is playable and at least not spammy like some other titles.

For me, this game was an opportunity to immerse myself in the world of game development. I learned a lot (both dos and don'ts) and look forward to perhaps being able to convince better in the future with a different game idea and implementation.

To everyone reading this: Thank you for everything!

Greetings

Finnchen[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.4.0
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

After the update 1.3.1 I did a long time nothing on this game... I had some other stuff going on and had no real idea on what to improve in the next update. But now I am back with the biggest update so far. And the most important change: [b]3D-Objects[/b]. Here are all the changes:

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Interact popup to visualize the range of interaction better
[*] Added animations to some 3D object
[*] Added a daylight cycle (3h day, 3h night in real time)
[*] There are 4 new ores (tin, copper, gold, iron)
[*] You can now enter a house with a certain chance
[*] You can now play this game on linux as well
[*] The mouse is now used to look around
[*] 3D-Objects to everything except NPCs
[*] NPCs give now up to 4 different quests (Explore, Kill, Collect, Find)
[/list]

[b]Removed[/b]
[list]
[*] UI Buttons in the player HUD
[/list]

[b]Changed[/b]
[list]
[*] Water slime -> Forest slime
[*] Reworked options menu
[*] Reworked mouse handling
[*] Reworked quest menu
[*] Small UI overhaul
[*] Cities are now randomly generated and not just copy/paste
[*] Updated options and game save mechanic
[*] Updated the shop page with new screenshot and changed the text a bit
[/list]

I already have the next few things in mind for the next update. I don't know when the next update will be but it will be a bit earlier than next year :D

Kind regards,
Finnchen123

notes.title: Version 1.3.1
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

After the update 1.3.0 I found some bugs/issues with the update. This update should fix most of them.

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Item trashcan to remove items from your inventory
[/list]

[b]Removed[/b]
[list]
[*] Nothing
[/list]

[b]Changed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed god mode achievement not working
[*] Fixed game win bug when discovering last city
[*] Fixed item scaling, rarity chances and item attributes
[*] Fixed Option close button not working
[/list]

I quickly wanted to say that I am impressed with all of you. The update is out for four days... And despite the god mode achievement being unable to obtain in terms of coding, some of you still managed to get it. I don't know if I am impressed or shocked :D If one of you, who got the achievement reads this... please tell me how you got it. It should be impossible. XD

Kind regards,
Finnchen123

[b]Added[/b]

[/list]

[b]Removed[/b]
[list]
[*] Nothing
[/list]

[b]Changed[/b]
[list]

notes.content:

Have a great time.
Finnchen123
